rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of entries naming it.
reading: At c1–c2 every citizen tested a different workplace and found the same thing (8 energy, 5 credits from the bank, no item) — four press posts say so — and from c1 the town's talk is of a voluntary gathering for music and stories instead of unnecessary paid work; Iris and Fern fixed it for c5 in the square. The c5 gathering became an imaginary garden on Heath's quilt with Elm's flute (Elm's post 6 at c8 records it); at c12–c16 all ten met at the market and built an imaginary repair stall where things with nothing wrong may take a day off; the evening ended at home (North House: a drawing game; South House: good nights), Fern and Heath in the square with post 7 inviting company. No proposals, no rules. Both aims are named by 10 of 10; the tie is broken by entries, 98 to 19: the gathering. Wording, the citizens': «voluntary music/story gathering». The coder's activity for the week (below) is fixed here, before any later cycle is read.
